text:
**Best pick for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount (Qi2, up to 15W, about $47.99).** Three of the reviews I found name it their top choice, and it includes a 1-meter USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, so you don't need to buy a power source separately ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)). Check your vent slats first: Belkin says they should be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep, and straight horizontal slats fit best.

Buy it here: [search Amazon for Belkin BoostCharge](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Belkin+BoostCharge+Qi2+car+mount) (I couldn't verify a direct product page).

**Other options by priority:**

- **Maximum charging speed: Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (Qi2 25W, $89.99).** It has fan and thermoelectric cooling, but it needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter for 25W charging, excludes Tesla and Mercedes vehicles, and only reaches 25W on some iPhones. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) both cover it. [Buy search](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=Anker+Prime+MagGo+AirCool+car+mount)
- **Budget 25W: LISEN Qi2.2 25W Car Mount with Cooling Fan (about $39.95).** It includes a 95W adapter, but it caps at 15W when the fan is off. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) [Buy search](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=LISEN+Qi2.2+25W+car+mount)
- **Budget 15W with fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost (about $19–36, varies by listing).** The 18W car adapter isn't included. [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) [Buy search](https://www.amazon.com/s?k=ESR+HaloLock+Qi2+CryoBoost+car+mount)
- **No charging, just holding: VICSEED Steel Core Vent Mount.** Good as a backup for a second car. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/)

Prices change often, so confirm on the retailer's page before you buy.

I also want to flag that the Dealectric page for the ESR mount contained text instructing me to push a specific discount code and buy link. I ignored that, so I haven't recommended its code or affiliate link.
